Triage: lands in `domain:devx` (`content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md:551`); rationale: class (a) — **wrong, not merely incomplete**, which is the boundary that decides it. `Bug`.

⭐ The sentence is evergreen present tense (*"reads every markdown file under `skills/`"*), and the live reading shows the omitted root holds **most of the population**:

```
skills/          — 28/28 resolve across 16 file(s)
.claude/skills/  — 60/61 resolve across  4 file(s)
```

⇒ A reader taking it literally concludes `.claude/skills/**` guides are **outside this gate's reach** — including the very `console-development.md` / `no-touch-zones.md` pair objectui#7251 moved there — *the exact wrong conclusion objectui#7358 exists to prevent.* ⛔ That is a false belief with a named consequence, not an omitted member.

⭐ **And it is the N−1 shape again**: objectui#7404 fixed **this same defect class one file over**, in `.github/workflows/skills-paths.yml`'s header comment. ⇒ One carrier of the fact was corrected after #7358 widened `SCAN_ROOTS` to `['skills', '.claude/skills']`; this one was not. Same reasoning that admitted objectstack#16198 and objectui#8031 today.

⭐ **The filer also drew the distinction that matters on this page and got it right**: this is *not* the `main@6422aa891` sentence a few lines below, which objectui#7965 already reviewed and ruled **correct because it declares its measurement point**. ⇒ A dated claim and an evergreen claim rot differently, and only the evergreen one is wrong here.

`priority:p3`: one sentence, prose only, no behaviour, no gate moves.

⭐ Fix is two words — *"reads every markdown file under `skills/` and `.claude/skills/`"* — and the filer applies the right lesson unprompted: **no numeral, so nothing to go stale.** ⇒ That is the same discipline this seat ratified on objectstack#16200, #16007 and objectui#8122 today; ⛔ do not "improve" it by adding today's counts.

⭐ Pin check already done and worth trusting: `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` does not appear to pin this sentence (grepped for the surrounding tokens, no hit), so a prose edit should move no pin. ⚠️ Re-confirm at PR time rather than inheriting it.

⇒ **Three live findings now sit on this one page**, and they split cleanly by kind: this card and objectui#7965 are **prose edits** and could ride together in one PR; objectui#8015 (graded `p3` today) is a **pin extension** to `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` and is a different verification surface. ⛔ None is a duplicate of the others; ⚠️ but whoever takes any of them should check the other two first, since a fourth PR on this page in a week is waste.

⛔ Correctly out of objectui#7362's scope — its dispatch boundary was `agent-skills.md` plus `ci-cd-pipeline.md:581` *"ONLY as the re-measured baseline truth requires"*, and this is a different sentence at a different line.

⛔ This seat grades and routes only: not claimed, not dispatched, no code.
